name: bottom-sheet
gotchas: `MatBottomSheet.open()` returns a `MatBottomSheetRef` immediately, before the sheet component is instantiated — code that needs to run after the sheet closes belongs in `afterDismissed()`, not right after the `open()` call.
Data passed via `open(Component, { data })` is only readable inside the sheet component through `inject(MAT_BOTTOM_SHEET_DATA)` — it is not a component `@Input()`.

Clicking an item inside the sheet content doesn't dismiss the sheet by itself — call `MatBottomSheetRef.dismiss(result)` explicitly from the click handler, otherwise the sheet stays open until the backdrop is clicked or Escape is pressed.
